comments.text: Hello Guys Thank you so much for the video you shared — I can’t thank you enough, it has helped me a lot. As a woman, I have to install the fence on my own. I have a question: is there a ratio between the height of the fence and the depth of the holes that need to be dug? If so, what is it? Plus, putting small iron stick into the holes and then fence bar helps to make sure fence stays in correct position? Greetings from Türkiye 😀
